fusions.name: Split Glance
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Tines Apart
fusions.desc: A two-pronged thrust that deals 14 damage, leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Parting of Ways
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier 4 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Branching Sight
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage, then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 6 seconds.
